name: Suite 4: Customer Checkout and Order Tracking

planSteps.description: Fill the login field with customer@wajbati.local and password field with Password123!
The user is authenticated and redirected away from login
Navigate to the meals catalog at /meals
Click on the first available meal to view its details
Click the Add to Cart button
The shopping cart page renders with the added meal and delivery fee
Fill the delivery address field with 'Ramallah, Main Street, Building 4' and the phone field with '+970599123456'
The user is redirected to /orders and the orders table displays the placed order
Click the view order details link for the newly placed order
The order details page loads with the order items and summary
